name: branch-management
description: Branch lifecycle skills. new-branch cuts a fresh branch inline; new-pr runs iterative parallel review rounds (claude/codex/copilot/coderabbit reviewers) backed by subagents, applies verified fixes between rounds, opens a PR/MR via gh or glab, and watches CI until green. Optionally refreshes a graphify output folder on new-branch and before the PR push (separate commit). Uses context-mode to keep heavy script output out of context when it is installed, with a native Bash fallback otherwise.

review_claude.title: Claude reviewer
review_claude.description: Values: true = run the claude-reviewer subagent during new-pr review rounds; false = skip it. Default: true.

review_codex.title: Codex reviewer
review_codex.description: Values: true = run the codex-reviewer subagent (requires codex CLI login); false = skip it. Default: true.

review_copilot.title: Copilot reviewer
review_copilot.description: Values: true = run the copilot-reviewer subagent (requires copilot CLI login); false = skip it. Default: true.

review_coderabbit.title: CodeRabbit reviewer
review_coderabbit.description: Values: true = run the coderabbit-reviewer subagent (requires coderabbit CLI login); false = skip it. Default: true.

ci_monitor.title: CI monitoring
ci_monitor.description: Values: true = watch CI results after the PR/MR is opened; false = stop after opening the PR/MR. Default: true.

ci_watch_timeout.title: CI watch timeout (seconds)
ci_watch_timeout.description: Values: positive whole-number seconds for the CI watch deadline; invalid or missing values fall back to 1800. Default: 1800.

context_index.title: context-mode indexing
context_index.description: Values: true = refresh the context-mode index after creating a new branch; false = skip the refresh. Default: true.

coderabbit_ci_comments.title: CodeRabbit CI comments
coderabbit_ci_comments.description: Values: true = collect and address open CodeRabbit bot comments while watching CI; false = ignore them. Default: true.

graphify_branch_update.title: graphify update on new branch
graphify_branch_update.description: Values: true = refresh the graphify output after creating a new branch; false = skip that refresh. Default: true.

graphify_force_create.title: graphify force create
graphify_force_create.description: Values: true = create a missing graphify-out/ folder during new-branch and run the update anyway; false = never create the folder automatically. Default: false.

graphify_pr_update.title: graphify update before PR
graphify_pr_update.description: Values: true = refresh the graphify output after the review rounds and before pushing in new-pr; false = skip that refresh. Default: true.

graphify_pr_commit.title: graphify separate commit
graphify_pr_commit.description: Values: true = commit refreshed graphify-out files as a separate commit during new-pr; false = leave them uncommitted. Default: true.

graphify_user_files.title: graphify human-only outputs
graphify_user_files.description: Values: true = keep human-only graphify outputs such as graph.html after updates; false = prune them. Default: false.

review_max_rounds.title: Max review rounds
review_max_rounds.description: Values: positive whole-number cap on iterative review rounds; invalid or missing values fall back to 3. Default: 3.
